roadmap_row.qualification_note: The frozen row is stale relative to current evidence. The named module/test exist, but current behavior is a read-only ROI portfolio report over recorded rows; no proactive detection or pruning/archive lifecycle is implemented.

frozen_contract.bounded_bank_rule: The skill bank must stay bounded.
frozen_contract.acceptance_gate_interpretation: Gardener review may recommend maintenance actions from evidence; the frozen text does not define automatic thresholds, does not grant autonomous deletion authority, and does not override §119 promotion evidence, §127 rollback, Constitution/security rules, or human-approval boundaries. Negative ROI is a review signal in the current implementation, not pruning authority.

canonical_p3_15.exact_skill_gardener_lifecycle: The only explicit frozen lifecycle is §88 IDEA -> SHADOW -> MEASURED -> ADVISORY -> ACTIVE -> MONITORED -> REVISE / RETIRE. Current repository path directories additionally include candidate, shadow, staged, approved, active, quarantine, and retired; promotion.py implements guarded forward shadow/candidate/active moves plus manual demotion to lower levels, but no implemented Gardener transition to retired/archive.

current_implementation_state.gardener_py: SkillGardener.audit_portfolio() only calls SkillROILedger.list_all() and partitions measured SkillROISummary objects into healthy/degraded/review lists. It performs no scans for dead, overlap, false-trigger, never-used, duplicate, broad/narrow, or model-specific-quirk conditions, and returns no merge/narrow/demote/hide/retire action plan beyond the existing SkillHealth recommendation text.
current_implementation_state.roi_input: P3.14 now composes version-bound measured/estimated ROI evidence, but SkillGardener consumes only SkillROILedger's measured summaries. There is no Gardener-specific linkage from a summary back through P3.10 Radar, P3.11 evaluation, P3.12 promotion records, or P3.13 counterfactual evidence, and no evidence gate before any gardening action because no action executor exists.
current_implementation_state.negative_roi: SkillHealth.DEGRADED is produced for negative net_tokens_saved or success_rate < 0.60; the recommendation says review or deprecate. This is a signal/report, not authority: audit_portfolio() never calls promotion.demote(), never moves a skill to retired/quarantine, never deletes anything, and never auto-promotes positive ROI.
current_implementation_state.lifecycle_mutations: promotion.py.demote() is a separate manual mutation primitive: it supports any lower LEVEL_RANK transition among shadow/candidate/active and writes a reason-bearing promotion record, but no retired level exists in promotion.LEVELS, no gardener calls it, and no archive/restore/retire function exists. skills/retired and skills/quarantine directories are present but contain only .gitkeep.
current_implementation_state.stale_broken_superseded: skillforge.audit_lifecycle() detects frontmatter/directory mismatch, missing SKILL.md, active execution placeholders, missing active promotion records, and corrupt promotion records. It does not classify stale/unused/duplicate/superseded skills for Gardener action, and SkillGardener.audit_portfolio() does not consume audit_lifecycle().
current_implementation_state.owner_version_rollback: P3.12 promotion records now carry owner/candidate_id/baseline_comparison/rollback_clear/resulting_version for newly governed promotions, but SkillGardener reads none of those records and does not require them before any proposed maintenance action. Existing rollback API is an immune-clear promotion guard, not a Gardener retirement rollback workflow.
current_implementation_state.config: config/skills.toml [gardener] lists the nine §62 sweep targets (dead_skills, overlap, false_triggers, never_used, negative_roi, duplicates, too_broad, too_narrow, model_specific_quirks), but the file explicitly says only router.max_active is enforced and all other keys are documented defaults; no runtime reader wires these targets into gardener.py.
current_implementation_state.cli: cli.py exposes promote, demote, promotions and credit/governor commands, but no gardener/skill-gardener/retire/archive command. The plan lists brainctl skills retire, but the current CLI implementation does not provide it.
current_implementation_state.production_safety: No production active skill was removed or changed during qualification. The current implementation has no automatic active-skill removal path; this is an observed absence, not a complete safety contract. The user explicitly prohibited acting on read-reuse's P3.14 DEGRADED result, and no such action occurred.

reuse_decision: Any future P3.15 implementation must extend SkillGardener and compose existing P3.10 Radar signals, P3.11 Skill Forge quality/evaluation/lifecycle metadata, P3.12 owner/version/rollback promotion evidence, P3.13 counterfactual observed effects, and P3.14 measured Skill ROI/SkillHealth. Do not create a new economics ledger or parallel lifecycle system. Keep review distinct from promotion authority; do not auto-promote positive ROI or auto-retire negative ROI. A future retirement path must be reversible/archive-first, preserve evidence/history, require deterministic evidence and appropriate owner/approval/rollback checks, and explicitly define stronger protection for active production skills. Do not act on read-reuse's DEGRADED signal during this qualification. Lean remains HOLD_SHADOW.
smallest_genuine_missing_seam: SkillGardener currently produces only an aggregate report over already-recorded ROI rows. It has no deterministic Gardener review sweep composing Radar/Skill Forge/promotion/counterfactual/ROI evidence, no differentiated review policy for dead/unused/duplicate/stale/broken/superseded/negative-ROI skills, no evidence/owner/version/non-regression/approval/rollback gate before action, and no reversible retirement/archive path. Existing demote() is a separate manual lower-level mutation primitive, not a Gardener authority. No current OMP-primary dogfood proves safe real-skill review or pruning. The smallest complete P3.15 seam is therefore a read-only, evidence-composing Gardener review boundary first; retirement/archive action must remain separately gated and reversible, with no automatic active-skill removal.
